title: 第14章 苦境武盟第25章 天才的世界太爽了
content_zh:
李青山听了王孝的话，立刻意识到，前面那些类现代产物，出处就是王孝口中的苦境。
难道是这个世界，有其他世界的通道？
一想到这点。
李青山心里跟有蚂蚁在爬一般，痒得很。
对方既然大大方方的说出来。
说明这玩意本身，就不是什么隐秘的事情。
李青山想了想道：“教习，我见这小盒子的风格不似我们这一片，这苦境莫不是离我们很远？”
王孝闻言，摇摇头：“没啥远的，整个武盟麾下，每一个县、府、郡，都有属于自己的苦境，铁腿门也有。”
见李青山一脸懵逼，无法理解的模样。
王孝轻笑：“算了，反正你以后都要接触这些，我今天就简单和你说说这些常识...我们吃完再说。”
说完，他朝大门招招手：“小虎，弄点吃的。”
话音落下。
之前融入府门、虎头虎脑的小娃娃，化作一道虹光，出现在两人面前。
它不满地看向王孝：“小虎也是你能叫的，叫虎爷！”
王孝也不恼：“别闹了，快去。”
小虎冷哼一声，遁入一旁小房间。
吩咐完。
王孝似笑非笑地看向李青山：“小虎是镇灵，我女儿从小调教的，是不是很有意思？”
李青山一脸木然：“我感觉自己像只井底的青蛙，出了村，才发现我们生活在两个不同的世界。”
“哈哈哈...”

王孝乐了：
“井底之蛙？
你倒是个会形容的。
别说你。
很多几代都生活在县城的人，也不知晓苦境的存在。
对于那些苦境产出的东西。
他们也只以为是其他地方生产的。”
说话间。
前面小屋的门弹开。
几句话的功夫，小虎已经带着两个托盘，飘着来到了两人面前。
它挥挥手。
托盘上的盖子飞起，露出里面的东西。
两个托盘上，都摆着一块生肉。
李青山面前的托盘，肉只有成人巴掌大小，颜色暗红，表面的肌肉纤维疯狂跳跃蠕动，看着和刚刚割下来的牛肉差不多。
他心中惊叹：“这肉的活性好强！”
随着肉块表面的纤维蠕动，有奇异香味升腾，涌入鼻腔。
content_en:
After listening to Wang Xiao's words, Li Qingshan immediately realized that the previous quasi-modern products came from the difficult situation Wang Xiao mentioned.
Could it be that this world has passages to other worlds?
The thought of this.
Li Qingshan felt like there were ants crawling in his heart, itching very much.
Since the other party said it openly and openly.
This shows that this thing itself is not a secret thing.
Li Qingshan thought for a while and said: "Teacher, I see that the style of this small box is not like ours. Is this plight far away from us?"
Wang Xiao heard this and shook his head: "It's not that far away. Every county, prefecture, and county under the entire Martial League has its own plight, including the Iron Leg Gate."
Seeing Li Qingshan's confused and incomprehensible look.
Wang Xiao chuckled: "Forget it, you will be exposed to these things in the future anyway. I will briefly talk about these common senses with you today... We will talk about it after eating."
After saying that, he waved towards the door: "Xiaohu, get some food."
The words fell.
The little doll with a tiger head and a tiger brain that had previously integrated into the mansion turned into a rainbow light and appeared in front of the two of them.
It looked at Wang Xiao with dissatisfaction: "You can also call me Little Tiger, Lord Tiger!"
Wang Xiao was not annoyed: "Stop making trouble and go quickly."
Xiaohu snorted coldly and escaped into a small room nearby.
Finished the order.
Wang Xiao looked at Li Qingshan with a smile but not a smile: "Xiaohu is the Zhenling. My daughter has been trained since she was a child. Isn't it interesting?"
Li Qingshan looked blank: "I feel like a frog at the bottom of a well. After leaving the village, I realized that we live in two different worlds."
"Hahaha..."
Wang Xiao was delighted:
“A frog in a well?
You are good at describing it.
Don't talk about you.
Many people who have lived in the county for generations are unaware of the existence of the plight.
For those things that come from hard times.
They just thought it was produced elsewhere. "
While talking.
The door to the cabin ahead popped open.
Within a few words, Xiaohu had floated up to the two of them with two trays.
It waved.
The lid on the tray flew up, revealing its contents.
On both trays, there was a piece of raw meat.
On the tray in front of Li Qingshan, the meat was only the size of an adult's hand, dark red in color, and the muscle fibers on the surface jumped and squirmed wildly. It looked similar to the beef that had just been cut off.
He exclaimed in his heart: "This meat is so active!"
As the fibers on the surface of the meat squirm, a strange aroma rises and pours into the nasal cavity.
